corinthians1.11.p1.b1.text: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.

corinthians1.11.p1.b2.text: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.

corinthians1.11.p1.b3.text: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

corinthians1.11.p2.b4.text: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.

corinthians1.11.p2.b5.text: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head …

corinthians1.11.p2.b6.text: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.

corinthians1.11.p3.b7.text: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

corinthians1.11.p3.b9.text: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.

corinthians1.11.p4.b10.text: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.

corinthians1.11.p4.b11.text: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.

corinthians1.11.p4.b12.text: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.

corinthians1.11.p5.b13.text: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.

corinthians1.11.p5.b14.text: … Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing?

corinthians1.11.p5.b15.text: What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!

corinthians1.11.p6.b16.text: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,

corinthians1.11.p6.b17.text: “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

corinthians1.11.p7.b18.text: “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”

corinthians1.11.p7.b19.text: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.

corinthians1.11.p8.b20.text: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

corinthians1.11.p8.b21.text: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.

corinthians1.11.p8.b22.text: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.

corinthians1.11.p9.b23.text: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.

corinthians1.11.p9.b24.text: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.

corinthians1.11.p10.b25.text: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

corinthians1.11.p10.b26.text: … And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
